controls.name: C1_sweep_finds_a_committed_path
controls.must_fire_because: the ref sweep must find a path that IS committed, else F1's zero is inertness rather than absence
controls.can_fail_because: a bad prefix or an empty ref set returns 0 for G36 too
controls.null_must_contain: paths under a directory that IS committed (G36's), so a zero for G34 is absence

observations.what_would_fail_it: a ref sweep that returns nothing for a path that IS committed

controls.name: C2_archive_is_head_not_tree
controls.must_fire_because: the F2 tree must be HEAD and not the working tree, else the reproduction runs against the very files under test
controls.can_fail_because: G34's directory appearing inside the archive
controls.null_must_contain: both answers: an archive that leaks the working tree would show G34 present

observations.what_would_fail_it: G34's directory appearing in a HEAD archive, or G36's missing from it

controls.name: C3_comparator_can_report_differ
controls.must_fire_because: the sha256 comparison behind F3 must be able to say DIFFER
controls.null_must_contain: a DIFFER verdict, produced here from a one-bit mutation of the same file

observations.what_would_fail_it: a sha256 comparison that returns equal for a one-bit change

controls.name: C4_repro_can_miss
controls.must_fire_because: F2 compares against literals transcribed from G34/RESULT.md, not against a value read from the run being checked
controls.can_fail_because: the generator writing no arm, so there is nothing to compare
controls.null_must_contain: a MISS: any arm, filter or split change moves the 4 dp literals it compares to

observations.compared_against: literals transcribed from G34/RESULT.md, not from this run
observations.what_would_fail_it: a comparison against a value read from the same run it is checking

controls.name: C5_answer_was_produced_not_shipped
controls.must_fire_because: the answer read by F2 must be one the generator WROTE this run; the HEAD archive ships a committed copy at that path
controls.can_fail_because: the generator failing to recreate the file the probe deleted before running it
controls.null_must_contain: the shipped-answer case: v1 read exactly that file and this control is what sees it

observations.what_would_fail_it: reading a length1_constants.json the generator did not write this run

falsifiers.name: F1_G34_reachable_from_some_ref
falsifiers.can_fail_because: git ls-tree over every ref, reflog entry and stash finds one path under G34's directory
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a reachable path, which C1 proves the same sweep does return for G36
falsifiers.refutes: that G36 compared against an artifact no clone contains; if G34 is reachable from ANY ref the whole row is withdrawn
falsifiers.fires_when: git ls-tree over every ref, reflog entry and stash finds one path under G34's directory
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F2_clean_HEAD_tree_reproduces
falsifiers.can_fail_because: the freshly written answer's rounded mrr and hits10 differ from the published literals
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a differing number: the literals come from G34/RESULT.md, not from this run
falsifiers.refutes: that the finding is larger than attribution; a clean HEAD tree returning 0.2648 / 0.3929 means the mission proposition survives on G36's copy
falsifiers.fires_when: the freshly written answer's rounded mrr and hits10 differ from the published literals
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifiers.name: F3_generators_differ
falsifiers.can_fail_because: G36's committed generator and G34's on-disk original hash differently
falsifiers.null_must_contain: a DIFFER verdict, which C3 demonstrates the same comparator produces
falsifiers.refutes: the 'same program' claim this row rests on
falsifiers.fires_when: G36's committed generator and G34's on-disk original hash differently
falsifiers.verdict: survived — the falsifier did not fire

falsifier: G34's directory turning out to be reachable from some ref (F1), which would make G36's 'the committed one' true and retire the row entirely
